payload.summary: FINDING that contradicts the resolved decision on y6344y07 — measured in the browser, not reasoned. The decision said reserve the rotated card's painted width with a symmetric margin-inline. Doing so measurably breaks the hand: .hand-cards is a flex row whose lane at 1280 is 294px, and three cards plus the reserve need 340, so .card (no flex-shrink) shrank from 90px to 76.67px — every card in the hand visibly resized the moment a third card landed. Backing the reserve down to the inboard half only fixed the shrink (87.3px) but left the painted card 6.3px ON THE WOOD RAIL, confirmed by screenshot: the sideways card is the outboard item in its lane, so its outboard half hangs past the felt gutter. Corrected approach, verified at 1440 and 1000: DISPLACE the overhang rather than reserve it — margin-inline outboard +overhang against inboard -overhang, netting zero layout width. Cards stay at their full 92px, lane overflow is 0, the third card clears the rail by 90px at 1440, and what remains is an 8px overlap onto the pair, which is what the reference photo shows a live layout doing.
